exposure: Type of healthcare facility (public vs. private)
cohort: 835 women aged 15-19 years who had given birth in the last 1-3 years in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
finding: The study found a high rate of cesarean section (CS) deliveries in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, with a significant proportion lacking clear medical indications and a higher prevalence observed in private healthcare facilities and among women of higher socioeconomic status.
